**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause.** Deploy `dep-4471` to the gateway, shipped by a.novak from 2:12 AM to 2:14 AM on March 14, 2026. Title: "config: connection-per-request for pool isolation." It changed two settings: `gateway.pool.perRequest` flipped from `false` to `true`, and `gateway.timeout.upstreamMs` went from 2000 to 2500. That change exhausted the connection pool, which holds 20 slots. Every 503 since then logs the same error, `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`, all 20 slots in use and requests queued waiting.

**Impact window.** First 503 hit at 2:14:18 AM, 33 seconds after the deploy landed. Still ongoing at 3:59:27 AM, the last entry in the log, with 74 requests queued and waiting at that point. Over that stretch, 548 requests failed with a 503. Every route was hit: cart, session, catalog search, orders, checkout. Health checks kept returning 200 the whole time, so the gateway process itself never went down, it just couldn't get connections.

**Scope.** Gateway only. `worker.log` covers the same window and shows zero errors, every job finished OK.

**Rollback.** Roll back `dep-4471` on the gateway.
